title: Coast Guard rescues woman, dog from bottom of cliff near Ludington, Mich.
description: Petty Officer 2nd Class Stevie Ray Catala-Vargas, an aviation survival technician stationed at Coast Guard Air Facility Muskegon, maneuvers his way down a sheer cliff to locate a woman for rescue near Ludington, Michigan, July 19, 2019. The aircrew rescued a woman and her dog who had been stranded at the bottom of a cliff overnight. (U.S. Coast Guard video)
